product_lane: Mental Model Teacher Product Surface And Visual Library

classification_definitions.product-safe: A bounded, reviewed field or derived custody fact may appear in the product surface without exposing raw internal mechanics.
classification_definitions.product-safe-after-translation: The asset may power user-facing pages only through a later product contract, with raw paths, routing metadata, extraction metadata, ranking internals, and unsupported claims removed or reframed.
classification_definitions.internal-only: The asset may support implementation, validation, custody, or evidence discipline, but must not appear as product copy or visible proof.
classification_definitions.future/suggestion-only: The asset may inform later navigation, clustering, suggestions, or advanced teaching after a separate review gate; it is not a v0 user-facing source of truth.

assets.product_safe_use: Canonical doctrine and examples can seed model explanations, common misuse, and source-backed references.
assets.translation_rule: Extract bounded product fields and cite source custody; do not render raw Markdown as the page UI.
do_not_expose: raw source dump as product page
unreviewed claims beyond the source text

assets.product_safe_use: The manifest can verify source file identity and source hashes after path redaction.
assets.translation_rule: Expose repo-relative source file names and hashes only; never expose copied-from local paths.

assets.product_safe_use: Hash values can support user-visible custody receipts when paired with repo-relative source refs.
assets.translation_rule: Carry hash algorithm and file hash values without raw local provenance fields.

assets.product_safe_use: Reviewed select_when, avoid_when, input/output type, reasoning type, and provenance fields can power use/avoid sections.
assets.translation_rule: Translate routing-normalized fields into plain user-facing use and avoid language with visible missingness.

assets.product_safe_use: Failure modes, premortem questions, heuristics, mitigations, and practice-relevant material can power teaching sections.
assets.translation_rule: Preserve source quotes/refs and confidence while presenting concise failure and practice language.
do_not_expose: raw extraction metadata as dominant UI
hidden review notes as product proof

assets.product_safe_use: Allies, antagonists, structured tensions, source quotes, confidence, and curation notes can power relation pages and graph edges.
assets.translation_rule: Surface only supported relations with plain-language story, confidence, source reference, misread risk, and non-claims.

assets.product_safe_use: Curated edge identity can power small graph neighborhoods and relation-page links.
assets.translation_rule: Use graph data as navigational teaching structure; show relation pages before taxonomy/ranking details.
do_not_expose: raw affinity or fan-adjusted rank as truth

assets.product_safe_use: The wider topology can inform later collections and global navigation after focused pages work.
assets.translation_rule: Keep full topology out of the first user surface; promote only reviewed, product-contracted slices later.
do_not_expose: full topology as first product screen

assets.product_safe_use: No v0 user-facing exposure. It may support internal semantic retrieval experiments.
assets.translation_rule: Semantic neighbors remain suggestions only until reviewed through relation semantics or another explicit gate.
do_not_expose: semantic similarity as validated relation semantics

assets.product_safe_use: Trusted chunks, subpatterns, structural signals, and reasoning signals can support teaching copy after custody checks.
assets.translation_rule: Use only checked-in-safe snippets or paraphrased product fields with source refs and missingness.
do_not_expose: internal chunk ids as primary UI

assets.product_safe_use: Family and cluster semantics can later become library collections or graph filters.
assets.translation_rule: Treat as future navigation scaffolding until collection pages have their own review gate.

assets.product_safe_use: Reviewed affordance and absence records can support advanced teaching pages later.
assets.translation_rule: Promote only reviewed, rewritten, product-safe affordance statements through a later gate.

assets.product_safe_use: Implementation reference for deterministic neighborhood behavior only.
assets.translation_rule: Use concepts for builders later; do not expose route traces or ranking machinery as product copy.

assets.product_safe_use: No v0 user-facing exposure; this remains an internal ranking/tiebreaker implementation detail.
